chunk_text: Should Saturn be in the 9th along with the Moon as the ascendant lord is in fall, the native will acquire food by begging.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 18 - EFFECTS OF THE 9th HOUSE (Part 2)
attr_name: Yoga for Acquiring Food by Begging

chunk_text: O Brahmin, these are the effects related to the 9th house. I shall explained (these) briefly. These may be (further) estimated with the help of the state of the lords of the ascendant and 9th and in other manners as well.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 18 - EFFECTS OF THE 9th HOUSE (Part 2)

chunk_text: I now explain the effects of the 10th house. Listen to these, O Maitreya, in the words of Brahma, Garga and others.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 21 - Effects of The Tenth House

chunk_text: If the 10th lord is strong and be in exaltation or in own navamsa, the native will be happy from the paternal side and be famous.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 21 - Effects of The Tenth House
